rationale: Houthis seize Perim island (Red Sea strategic chokepoint) continues shipping/energy threat affecting Black Sea trade routes; Israel-Hezbollah escalation continues; other events distant.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize Perim island Red Sea route
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis capture strategic Perim island on Bab al-Mandab Strait, tightening control over major shipping lane. Continues threat to Black Sea region energy and goods transit.

top_events.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
top_events.label: Israel destroys major Hezbollah underground base
top_events.summary: Powerful blast equivalent to magnitude 4.1 earthquake destroys underground base in Lebanon. Continues regional escalation with indirect energy market risk.

top_events.title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
top_events.label: Coach crash kills five in Swiss Alps
top_events.summary: Tourist coach carrying Dutch passengers overturns in southeastern Swiss Alps, killing five and injuring dozens. Tragic but no direct impact on Romania.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea route

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea route
most_significant_event.summary: Mokha capture brings Houthis closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a key waterway for Black Sea region trade and energy logistics affecting Romania.
most_significant_event.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
